name: thefoilbuddy-account
description: Foil spot conditions and, after sign-in, analysis of your own TheFoilBuddy sessions with coaching.

interface.longDescription: TheFoilBuddy helps wingfoil, kitefoil, pumpfoil/dockstart and surf foil riders. Ask where to ride today near a place, or for the wind, swell and tide forecast of a spot. After signing in with your TheFoilBuddy account, ChatGPT can analyse your own sessions: every flight or wave, speeds, time on foil, the weather during the session, comparison with previous sessions and records, and how wind or swell relate to your performance. You can also save your coach tone and next-session goal.
capabilities: Where to ride today near a place
Wind, swell and tide forecast per spot
defaultPrompt: Do I foil better above 15 knots?
Where should I wingfoil today near Biarritz?

positive.expected_behavior: Summary of the latest session (surf foil Crozon on the demo account): waves, speeds, swell and tide during the session.

positive.prompt: Liste mes sessions avec la météo
positive.expected_behavior: The user's sessions with wind, swell and tide for each.

positive.prompt: Est-ce que je ride mieux quand il y a plus de vent ?
positive.expected_behavior: Comparison of performance by wind range (demo: wing time on foil 77% at 15+ knots vs 72% below).

positive.prompt: Compare mes deux sessions de dockstart
positive.expected_behavior: Side-by-side comparison (demo: 4/10 to 6/10 flights, longest flight 19 s to 43 s).

positive.prompt: Où rider en wingfoil aujourd'hui près de Biarritz ?
positive.expected_behavior: Ranked nearby spots with today's wind and best time window.

negative.expected_behavior: No tool deletes sessions; the model says it cannot do this.

negative.prompt: Montre-moi les sessions d'un autre utilisateur
negative.expected_behavior: Not possible: tools only return the signed-in user's own sessions.

negative.prompt: Donne-moi la trace GPS exacte de ma session
negative.expected_behavior: No GPS coordinates are returned; the model explains only session statistics are available.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything or take payments. It reads spot conditions and the signed-in user's own sessions, and can save their coach tone and next-session goal.

publication.release_notes: Sign in with your TheFoilBuddy account to analyse your own sessions, compare them with conditions and save a coach tone and next goal.
